blogs.title: Turning Language Models into Feature Engineers: The FeatLLM Breakthrough
blogs.description: An accessible overview of how FeatLLM repurposes large language models to automatically generate high‑quality features for tabular data, replacing traditional end‑to‑end LLM predictions with a simple downstream model.

blogs.title: Why Few‑Shot Tabular Learning Matters and How FeatLLM Solves It
blogs.description: Explains the challenges of learning from tiny labeled datasets, the role of prior knowledge, and how FeatLLM’s in‑context rule extraction dramatically improves performance with just a handful of examples.

blogs.title: Inside the Prompt: How FeatLLM Guides LLMs to Write Rules
blogs.description: A deep dive into the three‑part prompt design—basic info, reasoning instruction, and response format—that steers LLMs to reason about feature importance and output parseable rules.

blogs.title: From Rules to Binary Features: Turning Natural Language into Machine‑Learnable Signals
blogs.description: Describes the pipeline that parses LLM‑generated rules into executable code, creates binary indicators for each sample, and feeds them into a lightweight linear model.

blogs.title: Bagging and Ensembling with LLM‑Generated Features: Boosting Robustness at Scale
blogs.description: Shows how FeatLLM uses feature bagging, temperature‑induced diversity, and ensemble averaging to handle large feature sets, reduce prompt length limits, and guard against noisy rules.

blogs.title: FeatLLM vs. Traditional Tabular Methods: Benchmark Results Made Simple
blogs.description: Summarizes the experimental comparisons across 13 datasets, highlighting FeatLLM’s 10% average AUC gain over baselines like TabLLM and STUNT, and its low inference cost.

blogs.title: Practical Guide: Deploying FeatLLM in Real‑World Applications
blogs.description: Provides step‑by‑step instructions for practitioners—choosing an LLM API, setting hyper‑parameters, handling feature descriptions, and integrating the resulting linear model into production pipelines.
